title: Connectivity Verification Activation Guide
description: Learn how to enable connectivity verification on your device

steps.title: Open Unetwork Tasks
steps.description: Launch the Unetwork app and navigate to the Tasks section using the bottom navigation bar.

steps.title: Select Connectivity Verification
steps.description: Tap on 'Connectivity Verification' from the list of available tasks to view details.

steps.title: Enable the Task
steps.description: Review the requirements and tap 'Enable' to start connectivity verification. The task will run automatically in the background.

steps.title: Optional: Grant Location Permission
steps.description: For more accurate coverage mapping, grant location permission when prompted. This helps associate connectivity data with geographic areas.
